title: Positive ordered tensor products of modules and their global sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For $n\geq 1$ and an ordered family $\mathcal F_1,\ldots,\mathcal F_n$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, define the left-associated tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] by $T_1=\mathcal F_1$ and $T_{k+1}=T_k\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal F_{k+1}$. For global sections $s_i$ of $\mathcal F_i$, define their pure tensor section recursively by $t_1=s_1$ and $t_{k+1}=t_k\otimes s_{k+1}$, where the binary section tensor is the image of the presheaf pure tensor under the sheafification map. In particular families indexed by sets $I_i$ induce a section of $T_n$ for every tuple $(j_i)\in\prod_i I_i$.
